rust_adapter.behavior: serde_json rejects unpaired surrogate escapes; the whole request body fails with an explicit parse error naming the failure mode and position

disposition.decision: Rust rejects lone UTF-16 surrogate code units in client input with an explicit parse error (HTTP 400 + JSON-RPC -32700 with detail). stdio lines carrying lone surrogates follow the existing unparseable-line contract (silent skip). Valid surrogate pairs and all normal Unicode text remain accepted and must keep matching the oracle — verified by differential case stage.list.chapter-astral-pair and the js_slice complete-character truncation tests.
